comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for Droplets (9-knob). Granular delay: short grains sprayed from a 2.5 s buffer of what you played, with pitch patterns, randomness, feedback and a Lock that freezes the buffer. Pitch and Pattern are named-step knobs (labels: build/selector_metadata.py); the rest are 0..100.
fxid_comment: 0x01EC. In this project's reserved 403-499 Delay block; never used (gap between DirtBox 491 and Breather 493; 498 was the old NAMLite). Check repeat98's FXID registry before release.

params.name: Pitch
params.comment: params[5]. Named steps: -24, -12, -7, -5, -3, Unity, +3, +5, +7, +12, +24 semitones for every grain.

params.name: Size
params.comment: params[7]. Grain length 10 .. 250 ms, squared curve.

params.name: Contour
params.comment: params[8]. Grain envelope: 0 = sharp hit, 50 = smooth, 100 = slow swell with a sharp end.

params.name: Scan
params.comment: params[9]. 0..49: where grains start, 30 ms .. 2.5 s behind the live input (a place in the frozen buffer when Locked). 50..100: the start point travels through the last 2.5 s, still at 50 up to twice speed at 100.

params.name: Pattern
params.comment: params[10]. Named steps: pitch sequence stepped per grain, on top of Pitch. Off, Oct, Oct-, Fifth, Pwr, Maj, Min, Down, Sus (fixed cycles), Pent, Wide (random picks).

params.name: Random
params.comment: params[11]. 0..33: spray (random start, up to 0.5 s) and stereo spread; 33..66 adds random pitch jumps, size, timing and level; 66..100 adds reversed grains (up to half).

params.name: Feedbk
params.comment: params[12]. Grains back into the buffer, 0 .. 99; 100 = Lock: the buffer freezes (nothing new is recorded) and the grains keep playing from it.
